judge_response:
ANALYSIS (pair 1): The prediction describes normal postpartum physiologic changes, whereas the reference is endometritis, an infectious/inflammatory condition of the uterine lining. These are not equivalent—one is a pathologic infection requiring treatment, the other is benign postpartum physiology.

VERDICT (pair 1): INCORRECT

ANALYSIS (pair 2): Hirschsprung disease is congenital aganglionosis of the distal colon causing functional obstruction; imperforate anus is a structural anorectal malformation causing mechanical obstruction. They have distinct pathophysiology, presentation, and management, so they are not equivalent.

VERDICT (pair 2): INCORRECT
